column7: Two holders of WithAuditCheckpointLock after a silent lock loss (docs/design/pooler-lock-loss.md row 15): a holder that loaded the signed verification state before the other recorded a sticky failure can no longer drop that failure by saving its older state. saveAuditVerifyState writes with CompareAndSetSystemMetadata on the row the state was loaded from; updateAuditVerifyState redoes its merge once over the reloaded row, other writers fail and their next run retries. Proved with two cores on separate pools, SQLite and PostgreSQL. Not covered: replay of an older authentic row by a DB-level actor (docs/specs/audit-incremental-verification.md section 9).
